_note: Combat Patrol force definition. This is a SEPARATE game mode: a fixed force with its own datasheets (in data/combat-patrol/units/) and its own stratagems, which deliberately never mix with the matched-play data in data/units/ and data/stratagems.json. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the loader. Awaiting Ork Combat Patrol data.
name: Orks Combat Patrol
_roster_help: The fixed force, in the order it should display. Each entry is either a plain unit id, or an object: {"unit":"id", "count":2, "ledBy":"character-id", "note":"free text"}. ledBy renders the character and its unit as one merged card. Unit files are loaded from this list automatically — add an explicit "units" array only if you need a datasheet that is not in the roster.
_rule_help: One rule object, or an array of them: {"name":"…", "description":"HTML"}.
_stratagems_help: Combat Patrol stratagems, keyed by id — same schema as data/stratagems.json but with no detachment field, since Combat Patrol has no detachments.
